changeSet.author: lifefit-architecture
changeSet.comment: Ticket: LF-0016. Attendance history and single-use QR check-in tokens. Attendance is not soft-deleted. Index review: PK on Id; UX_Attendance_OpenVisit allows one open visit per member so a second check-in is rejected by the database; IX_Attendance_TenantId_CheckInTime, IX_Attendance_BranchId_CheckInTime, and IX_Attendance_MemberProfileId_CheckInTime match dashboard, branch, and member history reads. GymMembershipId is not indexed separately because member history already starts from MemberProfileId and the open-visit index covers the active row. UX_QrCheckInTokens_TokenHash is the scan lookup. IX_QrCheckInTokens_MemberProfileId lists unused tokens. Performance note: the open-visit index is filtered to rows still inside the gym.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE app.Attendance ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, BranchId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, MemberProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, GymMembershipId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, CheckInTime DATETIME2 NOT NULL, CheckOutTime DATETIME2 NULL, CheckInMethod NVARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UpdatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, RowVersion ROWVERSION NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_Attendance PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_Attendance_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_Attendance_Branches FOREIGN KEY (BranchId) REFERENCES app.Branches (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_Attendance_MemberProfiles FOREIGN KEY (MemberProfileId) REFERENCES app.MemberProfiles (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_Attendance_GymMemberships FOREIGN KEY (GymMembershipId) REFERENCES app.GymMemberships (Id), CONSTRAINT CK_Attendance_Method CHECK (CheckInMethod IN (N'QR', N'Reception', N'Manual', N'Other')), CONSTRAINT CK_Attendance_Checkout CHECK (CheckOutTime IS NULL OR CheckOutTime >= CheckInTime) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_Attendance_OpenVisit ON app.Attendance (MemberProfileId) WHERE CheckOutTime IS NULL; CREATE INDEX IX_Attendance_TenantId_CheckInTime ON app.Attendance (TenantId, CheckInTime); CREATE INDEX IX_Attendance_BranchId_CheckInTime ON app.Attendance (BranchId, CheckInTime); CREATE INDEX IX_Attendance_MemberProfileId_CheckInTime ON app.Attendance (MemberProfileId, CheckInTime);
CREATE TABLE app.QrCheckInTokens ( Id UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TenantId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, MemberProfileId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NOT NULL, TokenHash NVARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, ExpiresAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, UsedAt DATETIME2 NULL, RevokedAt DATETIME2 NULL, CreatedAt DATETIME2 NOT NULL, CreatedByUserId UNIQUEIDENTIFIER NULL, CONSTRAINT PK_QrCheckInTokens PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_QrCheckInTokens_Tenants FOREIGN KEY (TenantId) REFERENCES app.Tenants (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_QrCheckInTokens_MemberProfiles FOREIGN KEY (MemberProfileId) REFERENCES app.MemberProfiles (Id), CONSTRAINT FK_QrCheckInTokens_Users FOREIGN KEY (CreatedByUserId) REFERENCES app.Users (Id) ); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_QrCheckInTokens_TokenHash ON app.QrCheckInTokens (TokenHash); CREATE INDEX IX_QrCheckInTokens_MemberProfileId ON app.QrCheckInTokens (MemberProfileId, ExpiresAt) WHERE UsedAt IS NULL AND RevokedAt IS NULL;

rollback.sql: DROP TABLE app.QrCheckInTokens; DROP TABLE app.Attendance;
